hypothesis: For Qwen3-4B, deterministic direct-context causal reachability accuracy may decline as irrelevant same-template causal edges increase while graph difficulty remains fixed.

controls.distractor_generation: unique disconnected causal edges in the identical record template
controls.question: Does SOURCE eventually cause TARGET? Return only YES or NO.
controls.evaluation: case-insensitive exact YES or NO after whitespace and terminal-punctuation normalization

selection_rationale: Pre-freeze calibration gave Qwen3-4B 4/4 at both two and three hops. The frozen rule selects the simplest non-floor candidate with accuracy at least 0.75, therefore two hops. Llama 3.2 3B returned no exact YES/NO answers at either candidate under the fixed 16-token contract, an output-format floor rather than a causal-difficulty comparison.
success_criteria: contiguous ECC threshold derivation when supported
